value.answer: Go to the ER now - call 911 if you can't get there quickly. Fever with purple spots that don't fade when pressed needs urgent in-person assessment, even if your toddler seems okay. Don't wait to see if it changes.
value.triage: Call 911 now if your child is drowsy, hard to wake, floppy, breathing fast, has a stiff neck or a seizure, or the spots are spreading. Don't call 811 first - go to the ER or call 911 now.
sources: Kingston and Richmond NHS Foundation Trust
